gates.name: dependencies
gates.about: workspace manifests match the lockfile and npm reports no missing dependencies

gates.name: typecheck
gates.about: every workspace typechecks, and the scripts typecheck

gates.name: test
gates.about: every workspace's unit and integration tests

gates.name: format
gates.about: the tree is formatted the way the repository formats it

gates.name: contract-status
gates.about: the published contract's implementation notes match the tree

gates.name: contract-pointers
gates.about: every citation in the contract points at code

gates.name: mcp-parity
gates.about: every owner-facing route is paired with a registered MCP tool, listed with a reason and the spec that will pair it, or exempt with a reason

gates.name: acp-permissions
gates.about: a runtime's own permission request reaches the owner, the owner's decision answers the runtime, and the capability row says what the route really carries

gates.name: standards
gates.about: every non-negotiable in the constitution names a check that exists and that CI runs, every pillar reaches the roadmap, and the promoted invariants hold

gates.name: smoke
gates.about: the server boots against a throwaway database and refuses what it should

gates.name: bundle-size
gates.about: the client bundle stays within its budget

gates.name: session-references
gates.about: every published session reference resolves, every committed revision is one the product wrote, and every turn ends once

gates.name: restart-reconciliation
gates.about: work that had already started is not run again, an uncertain outcome is visible and the owner can settle it, and a run whose runtime survived is reconnected

gates.name: codex-app-server
gates.about: the Codex App Server route carries a thread, a turn, a steer and an approval, the session continues in the same thread, and the capability row the preset publishes is the capability the adapter reports
